vacancies.assessment: Excellent technical subject match and direct ESTEC Test Centre exposure, but clearly a senior leadership role.

vacancies.title: Test Floor Supervisor & General Support Technician
vacancies.assessment: Useful spacecraft-test exposure but clearly under-level for an MSc mechanical engineer.

vacancies.title: GNC & Pointing Systems Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Delft-based specialist spacecraft pointing and attitude control engineering. Requires 5+ years directly relevant spacecraft GNC experience; significant stretch from mechanical engineering and no direct ESTEC placement. Official vacancy PDF.

vacancies.title: Test and Maintenance Engineer (HBO) – Space and High Tech
vacancies.assessment: Strong ESTEC hardware/test fit: mechanical vibration, acoustic, shock and mass-property testing in ESA’s Space Test Centre, including instrumentation, test preparation, facility maintenance and troubleshooting. Main caveat: HBO/Bachelor-oriented and potentially below MSc level, but direct ESTEC test experience could be strategically valuable.

vacancies.title: Senior Systems Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Senior spacecraft systems role in Delft; 8+ years dedicated systems engineering required. Not a direct ESTEC assignment.

vacancies.title: Manager Kwaliteit & Productborging – Ruimtesystemen
vacancies.assessment: Delft-based space PA and quality management, no direct ESTEC assignment. Requires 8+ years dedicated QMS/PA leadership and security management; senior stretch.

vacancies.title: Project Controls Engineer – Space Programmes
vacancies.assessment: Delft satellite project controls role; requires 5+ years dedicated project controls and EVM. Not an ESTEC posting; specialist PMO stretch.

vacancies.title: Project Support Officer
vacancies.assessment: Delft space programme support role; 2-5 years PMO experience, under-level relative to MSc mechanical design background.

vacancies.title: Test and Maintenance Technician (MBO) – Space and High Tech
vacancies.location: ESA Space Test Centre, ESTEC, Noordwijk
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC Space Test Centre exposure; MBO technician maintenance role is below MSc design/engineering seniority and likely below salary target. Distinct from existing HBO Test and Maintenance Engineer vacancy.

vacancies.title: Senior Space Vehicle Design Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strong hands-on mechanical CAD, complex assemblies, detailed design, drawing release, tolerances and DfMA fit, with ownership of complete machine projects. Senior/stretch: asks 8+ years of complex assembly configuration ownership; dedicated spacecraft/optical satellite experience is missing. Based in Delft rather than ESTEC; salary not disclosed. Dutch VGB-B clearance eligibility required.

vacancies.title: Senior Optomechanical Engineer / STOP Analyst
vacancies.assessment: Delft optical satellite role coupling thermal fields, structural deformation, alignment and optical performance. Good adjacency to thermal modelling, FEM and precision mechanisms; requires 5+ years specific optomechanical STOP work and Zemax/Code V with Nastran/Ansys, so senior specialist stretch. Not direct ESTEC; market-aligned salary without published range. Dutch VGB-B eligibility required.

vacancies.title: Senior Space Vehicle Mechanical and Structural Dynamics Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Delft optical satellite structural dynamics, micro-vibration, jitter, modal and coupled-loads analyses, qualification and correlation. FEM/COMSOL and modal-analysis thesis background relevant, but demands 5+ years ownership of structural models for space or comparable high-reliability systems, with Nastran/Abaqus/Ansys experience. Senior specialist stretch; no direct ESTEC and salary not specified. Dutch VGB-B eligibility required.

vacancies.title: Mission / System Architect
vacancies.assessment: Space mission and vehicle system architecture in Delft with multidisciplinary trade studies, technical decisions and customer reviews. Requires 10+ years specifically in space systems engineering and ownership of a spacecraft architecture; major senior specialist stretch beyond current experience. No direct ESTEC, salary not specified; Dutch VGB-B clearance eligibility required.

vacancies.title: Senior Command & Data Handling Engineer (on-board data architecture and FDIR)
vacancies.assessment: Senior Delft-based spacecraft command and data handling architecture and fault-management role. Requires 5+ years specialist spacecraft C&DH experience and space data standards. Relevant adjacent systems and verification exposure but a significant electronics/avionics stretch, without direct ESTEC placement.

vacancies.title: Senior AI&T Engineer – Space Systems
vacancies.assessment: Relevant spacecraft hardware integration, verification, environmental testing and ground support equipment. Senior stretch requiring eight years of AI&T and prior ownership of test campaigns. Delft rather than direct ESTEC placement.

vacancies.title: Technical Coordinator Test Facilities (MBO/HBO) – Space & High Tech
vacancies.location: ESTEC Space Test Centre, Noordwijk, Netherlands
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC Space Test Centre role coordinating test-floor readiness, cleanroom/airlock preparation, equipment and facilities for spacecraft test campaigns. Strong link to mechanical engineering, technical project coordination and hardware testing, but primarily MBO/HBO-oriented operations and facilities work rather than MSc-level mechanical design or spacecraft engineering. Salary unspecified; likely below preferred seniority. Distinct from test execution/maintenance engineer; verify overlap with previously listed Test Floor Supervisor & General Support Technician.
